    StartersTony's strawberries and whipped creamSugared strawberries with lemon and a bowl of softly whipped cream for dippingHow to make it2 punnets of strawberries, hulled and halved1 tbsp caster sugar1 lemon300ml thickened cream1 tbsp icing sugarToss the strawberries with the sugar and a squeeze of lemon.Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks.Serve the cream in a bowl beside the berries for dipping.Vanko's Russian pelmeniBeef and pork dumplings boiled and tossed in butter and dill, with sour creamHow to make it250g beef mince250g pork mince1 tsp salt24 dumpling wrappers100g butter, melted2 tbsp chopped dill300ml sour creamMix the beef and pork minces with salt and pepper.Fill the wrappers and pinch into little round parcels.Boil until they float, then a minute more.Toss in melted butter and dill and serve with plenty of sour cream.Monaco smoked salmon blinisThe race in MonacoHow to make itAs written, serves 4Warm little buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, salmon roe and chives, passed round like trackside in Monaco.Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 200ml milk into a thick batter.Drop teaspoons into a buttered frying pan over medium heat and cook 1 minute a side until golden, making about 24.Cool slightly.Top each with a little crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few salmon roe and snipped chives.MainsStark miso salmon rice bowlMiso honey glazed salmon over sushi rice with edamame, avocado and pickled gingerHow to make it2 tbsp white miso2 tbsp honey4 salmon fillets300g sushi rice200g frozen edamame, thawed2 avocados, sliced2 tbsp pickled gingerMix the miso and honey and brush over the salmon.Roast at 200°C until glazed. Cook the sushi rice at the same time.Serve the salmon over rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger.Birthday party eye fillet slidersTony's wild birthday party at the Malibu houseHow to make itAs written, serves 4Rare roast beef eye fillet sliced thin onto soft brioche buns with hot horseradish cream, rocket and crispy fried shallots.Season an 800g eye fillet, sear all over and roast at 220°C for 18 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice thinly.Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt.Split and lightly toast 12 brioche slider buns.Spread with horseradish cream, layer on the beef and a handful of rocket, and finish with crispy fried shallots.SweetsGiant sprinkle doughnutsFried yeast doughnut rings with a simple icing glaze and sprinklesHow to make it500g plain flour7g dried yeast50g butter, melted2 eggs250ml warm milk1 L vegetable oil250g icing sugar4 tbsp milk, for the glaze2 tbsp sprinklesMix the flour, yeast, butter, eggs and warm milk into a soft dough and knead briefly. Prove for an hour.Roll out, cut into rings and prove again.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C until golden, in batches.Dip in a glaze of icing sugar and milk and add sprinkles to some.DrinksArc reactor blue lagoonVodka, blue curaçao and lime topped with lemonade, with a booze-free swapHow to make it120ml vodka80ml blue curacao40ml fresh lime juice600ml chilled lemonade4 lime wheels1 bag crushed iceFill four tall glasses with crushed ice.Into each pour the vodka, blue curacao and lime juice, then top with chilled lemonade and stir gently.Garnish with a lime wheel. For a booze-free version, swap the vodka and curacao for blue cordial and extra lime.Green juice with kale and appleTony's chlorophyll fix, minus the palladium.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
